primary.rationale: Measures recovery of the measured behavioral target while avoiding trial-count weighting and block-average recall artifacts.

secondary: Mouse-macro log loss with probability clipping at1e-15.

evaluation.uncertainty: Implemented approximate95% t intervals across mice when at least two are scoreable; one mouse has no population interval. Cross-validation training overlap and small mouse count limit interpretation; report paired mouse effects and no cell/trial pseudoreplication.
